description: React component for user theme settings in Mattermost, allowing selection and customization of themes, including premade and custom options, with support for applying themes to all teams.

classes.name: ThemeSetting
classes.description: React component for managing user theme settings, including theme selection, customization, and application.

methods.name: getStateFromProps
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props, setting default theme if not provided.

methods.name: submitTheme
methods.description: Saves the current theme, optionally deletes team-specific themes, and updates UI state.

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Updates theme state and applies the theme.

methods.name: updateType
methods.description: Updates the theme type (premade or custom).

methods.name: resetFields
methods.description: Resets theme fields to initial state and reapplies theme.
